issues.claim: Jersey Home Furnishings, 337 Raritan Ave, Highland Park (furniture/mattress store)
issues.problem: Contradicted by the business's own site: jerseyhf.com is titled 'Furniture Store in Garfield NJ' and its contact page gives 70 Outwater Lane, Garfield, NJ 07026 with the identical phone 848-466-8121. The Highland Park address comes from a single mattress directory that itself says the store has not updated its details. Relocated business, i.e. wrong town.
issues.fix: Remove the entry (or move it to an out-of-zone list); keep it out of the outreach wave.

issues.claim: Ridgewood Diagnostic Lab - Highland Park, 220 S 6th Ave
issues.problem: The only cited page (Loc8NearMe) is a stale map listing. Ridgewood Diagnostic Laboratory's own contact page gives 126 State Street, Hackensack, and Highland Park borough records show the 220 S 6th Ave presence was a 2021 community COVID-testing arrangement, not a standing draw site. It is also a multi-site medical laboratory, i.e. a healthcare provider outside this CD zone's scope.
issues.fix: Drop the row; it is both out of date and an out-of-scope healthcare listing.

issues.claim: New York Auto Depot Inc., 205 Woodbridge Ave, Highland Park (used car dealer)
issues.problem: The dealer's own site (nyautodepot.com) lists 1849 Morris Ave, Union, NJ, so the Highland Park lot address is wrong/stale. The row was already flagged UNVERIFIED but was still carried with a Highland Park address and a Long Island phone number.
issues.fix: Remove the row, or re-file it as an out-of-zone dealer; do not contact on the Woodbridge Ave address.

issues.claim: About 45 of ~135 entries rest on one bulk aggregator only (us-business.info)
issues.problem: I confirmed the names and addresses really do appear on the cited us-business.info pages, so nothing is fabricated, but for many rows (Freese Camera Shop, All Colors, Network Typesetting, Spezio's Music, Central Jersey Organ & Piano, Coster's Gallery, I M Pottery Studio, Trio Israeli Gifts, Make Me Take Me, Ashley Pearl & Jewelry, Counterpoint Logistics, Kay's Transport, Corriguard Packaging, Ultra Chem, Champion Landscaping, Beta Mechanical, Maida's Cleaning and others) that aggregator is the only evidence: no second source, own site or review signal. Three sampled rows proved stale or relocated, which suggests a similar rate across the rest.
issues.fix: Split the list: keep own-site / multi-source rows for wave one, and put bulk-only rows in a 'needs verification' bucket so nobody calls a stale storefront.

issues.problem: The cited 'Our Space' page describes the space and capacity but never states the street address; 431 Raritan Ave surfaced only in a search snippet from the same squarespace domain. 431 Raritan Ave is also Local Bicycle Shop's address, so the floor/suite is unresolved.
issues.fix: Cite the venue's contact page for the address and record it as 431 Raritan Ave, 2nd floor.

issues.claim: Local Bicycle Shop, 431 Raritan Ave, phone (609) 290-6037
issues.problem: Address is confirmed on the cited page, but the phone differs from the one the same directory returns in search results ((732) 339-3885 New Jersey exchange vs a 609 area code in the list). Newest on-page review is from 2023, so 'active' is only weakly supported.
issues.fix: Re-read the phone off the listing before calling and label activity 'likely open, last review 2023'.

issues.problem: The loc8nearme jewelry-stores page I opened lists 327 Raritan Avenue, not 331. The disagreement is noted in the mapper's notes but 331 is kept in the address field.
issues.fix: Use 327 Raritan Ave or write '327/331 - confirm'.

issues.claim: Two roofers and one plumber with in-borough addresses are missing, and the notes claim Eleven Exterior is the only exterior firm in the borough
issues.problem: Independent searches found Martin & Sons Roofing (437 Raritan Ave), Fisher Roofing (76 S Adelaide Ave) and RCL Plumbing & Heating LLC (27 S 3rd Ave), all Highland Park and all absent from businesses.json.
issues.fix: Add the three contractors with source-quality notes (Birdeye; Yellow Pages/Superpages; Angi/BBB) and correct the 'only exterior firm' statement in categories_thin.
